newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama sets new public bid for dam project.
newsitem.headline: Panama sets new public bid for dam project.

text.p: Panama's plans to build the second largest hydro-electric power station in the country are back on track with a public bid scheduled for February 28, a government source said.
The project consists of a $300 million, 132-megawatt dam in western Chiriqui province, 150 miles (240 km) from the capital, the source at the Institute of Water Resources and Electricity (IRHE) said.

Four international consortiums headed by Swedish, Italian, Mexican and German firms were prequalified at the end of last year. They include Swedish construction group Skanska, German industrial giant Siemens AG, Italian construction group Impregilo Spa and Mexico's Empresas ICA Sociedad Controladora SA de CV.
A government commission last year threw out initial bids after some officials believed they were too high.
